world.title: Trump calls on Ukraine to halt strikes on Russian diesel fuel, says attacks causing shortage
world.summary: Former U.S. President Donald Trump urged Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy to cease strikes on Russian diesel fuel infrastructure, citing concerns over global fuel shortages and rising prices in the U.S. ahead of elections. Trump emphasized that the attacks are contributing to these shortages, highlighting the potential economic impact on American consumers as the political landscape shifts.

world.title: Nepal floods: The Himalayas are melting faster
world.summary: A new report indicates that Himalayan glaciers are melting at an accelerated rate, posing significant risks to India's water supply, economy, and communities. The report highlights the increasing instability of glacial lakes and the need for improved monitoring of the region. This environmental change could have far-reaching consequences for millions dependent on these water sources.

world.title: Sweden opposition holds one-seat advantage over ruling bloc, projection shows as vote counting continues
world.summary: Sweden's national election results are too close to call, with preliminary counts showing the left-wing opposition holding a narrow one-seat advantage over Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson's right-wing coalition. As vote counting continues, uncertainty remains regarding the final outcome. The election highlights a divided electorate, with both sides vying for control amid a tense political landscape.

business.title: Weak Monsoon, Crop and Food Inflation Risk
business.summary: India is facing a 14.7% monsoon deficit, exacerbated by a strong El Niño, which threatens crop yields and rabi production. This situation raises concerns about potential food inflation in the coming months. In August, six low-pressure systems formed, surpassing the climatological average, with LPS days totaling 26, exceeding the normal of 16.3 days for the month.

business.title: Brookfield looks to buy PGP Glass for up to $1.5 bn from Blackstone
business.summary: Brookfield is in talks to acquire PGP Glass from Blackstone for $1.3 billion. This transaction represents a notable move between two prominent alternative asset managers in India. Blackstone seeks to exit its six-year investment in the glass packaging firm, which specializes in packaging for cosmetics, spirits, and pharmaceuticals. A binding agreement is expected within the next two to three weeks.

business.title: Tata Sons may be valued up to ₹12.5 lakh cr in IPO
business.summary: Tata Sons' potential IPO valuation is estimated between ₹9-12.5 lakh crore, reflecting a discount on its underlying portfolio valued at ₹15-16 lakh crore. Investors will assess both listed stakes and unlisted businesses, applying a holding company discount. The Reserve Bank of India has denied Tata Sons' request to remain private, necessitating the conglomerate's public listing soon.

technology.title: AI must benefit humanity, stay under human control: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella
technology.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella emphasized that the development of superintelligence should prioritize benefits for humanity and maintain human control. He advocated for broader access to AI technology, ensuring that enterprises retain control over knowledge, and called for safeguards to prevent monopolization by a few entities. Nadella's statements highlight the importance of responsible AI development and governance.

technology.title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella backs need for evaluators for AI systems amid 'slowdown' debate
technology.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella emphasized the importance of human oversight and a measured approach to AI development. His remarks align with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call for a slowdown in AI advancements and the implementation of independent safety evaluators. This initiative has garnered support from prominent figures in the tech industry, including OpenAI's Sam Altman and Tesla's Elon Musk.

technology.title: iPhone 18 Pro in India: Jio, Airtel and Vi Show No Offer This Weekend, and Where the Cashback Sits
technology.summary: Jio, Airtel, and Vi have no iPhone 18 Pro offers listed on their websites for the pre-order weekend of September 13. The only confirmed cashback and EMI options available in India are provided by Apple through its official storefront. Consumers looking for promotional deals from these telecom providers will find no current offers for the new device.

sports.title: "Official admission of the scandal": the referees' committee acknowledges the error and confirms Haaland's goal was invalid
sports.summary: The Professional Game Match Officials (Pro Ref) officially notified Manchester United that Erling Haaland's winning goal for Manchester City in the derby at Old Trafford should have been disallowed. This admission confirms a significant error by the referees' committee regarding the match outcome, acknowledging the goal's invalidity and its impact on the game's result.

sports.title: Asia Cup: Indian women's cricket team refuses to accept trophy from ACC head Mohsin Naqvi
sports.summary: The Indian women's cricket team declined to accept the Asia Cup trophy from Asian Cricket Council chairperson Mohsin Naqvi after their victory over Sri Lanka on September 13, 2026. This marks the continuation of a trophy impasse for the second consecutive year. The refusal highlights ongoing tensions surrounding the presentation of the trophy within the cricketing community.

sports.title: IND vs AFG: Arshdeep, Abhishek power India to 7-wicket win over Afghanistan
sports.summary: India secured a 7-wicket victory over Afghanistan in the first T20I, successfully chasing down a target of 157 runs in just 13.4 overs. Abhishek played a standout innings, scoring 84 runs off 32 balls, including seven sixes. This win gives India a 1-0 lead in the three-match series against Afghanistan.

health.title: Severe period pain isn't always normal: Doctors explain endometriosis, genetic risks and why diagnosis can take years
health.summary: Severe menstrual pain, often dismissed as normal, can indicate endometriosis, a condition that affects many women. Symptoms may include debilitating pain, missed work or school, and sleep disturbances. Diagnosis often takes years due to a lack of awareness and understanding. Genetic factors may also play a role in the condition, highlighting the need for better education and medical attention.

health.title: Prakash Umbarkar: Advocating for the Radiation Therapy Specialty
health.summary: Prakash Umbarkar, a Scientific Officer at P. D. Hinduja National Hospital, promoted the Radiation Therapy Specialty on World Radiotherapy Awareness Day. He shared information about an international webinar scheduled for September 14, organized by the Association of Radiation Therapists and Technologists of India (ARTTI). Umbarkar emphasized the importance of radiation therapy in cancer treatment and encouraged registration for the event.

health.title: Nebraska Humane Society: Vets urge gradual weight loss for overweight pets
health.summary: Veterinarians from the Nebraska Humane Society emphasize the importance of gradual weight loss for overweight pets to mitigate health risks. While healthy pets have some padding, excessive weight can lead to serious issues. Owners should ensure their pets' skin moves easily over their bodies and that ribs are palpable, indicating a healthy weight and a definable waist.

science.title: SpaceX launches 3 telecom satellites to orbit on 700th Falcon mission of all time (video)
science.summary: SpaceX successfully launched three SES O3b mPOWER communications satellites into orbit on September 13, marking the 700th mission for the Falcon rocket family. The Falcon 9 rocket lifted off from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida at 2:49 p.m. EDT. This milestone highlights SpaceX's continued advancements in satellite deployment and telecommunications technology.

science.title: Earth’s moon may have formed nearly whole just hours after a giant crash
science.summary: New simulations indicate that Earth's moon may have formed almost immediately following a colossal impact, challenging the previous theory of gradual formation from debris. This event, occurring around 4.5 billion years ago, involved a Mars-sized body named Theia colliding with the young Earth. The findings suggest a rapid creation process for the moon, rather than a slow accumulation.

science.title: In 2015, Hawaii rescued fragments of a coral found only in Kaneohe Bay; after its wild colonies disappeared, scientists grew it in a nursery and returned it to the reef
science.summary: In 2015, fragments of a rare coral species, unique to Kaneohe Bay, Hawaii, were rescued after its wild colonies vanished. Scientists cultivated the coral in a nursery and successfully reintroduced it to its natural habitat. This effort marks a significant step in conservation, aiming to restore the biodiversity of the reef ecosystem in the region.

entertainment.title: 'Toxic' box office collection day 19: Yash, Tara Sutaria, Nayanthara, Kiara Advani starrer earns Rs 26 lakhs, taking India net to Rs 249.04 cr
entertainment.summary: On Day 19, Yash's film 'Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups' earned Rs 26 lakhs in India, marking a decline in box office performance. The film's total net collection in India now stands at Rs 249.04 crores. The earnings were recorded across 292 shows on Sunday, September 13, reflecting ongoing challenges in its theatrical run.

entertainment.title: Tom Holland becomes highest-grossing actor of all time with USD 15.5 billion haul; 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' nears end of box office run
entertainment.summary: Tom Holland has become the highest-grossing actor of all time, amassing USD 15.5 billion in total earnings. His latest film, 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day,' is projected to conclude its box office run with a worldwide total between USD 2.5 billion and USD 2.6 billion. The film continues to achieve significant milestones in its theatrical performance.

entertainment.title: Scorpio Shani Horoscope Today, 14th September 2026: Saturn Says Work Behind the Scenes; Chitra Moon Can Improve What Others Cannot See
entertainment.summary: On September 14, 2026, the Scorpio horoscope highlights Saturn in Pisces, urging maturity in emotional and creative decisions. The Moon in Libra, particularly in Chitra Nakshatra, supports subtle improvements in private endeavors. Individuals are advised to examine expenses related to hobbies carefully, emphasizing the importance of emotional intelligence and refined choices in personal and professional aspects of life.
